hints.title: Current Reach Window Expansion Strategy
hints.text: Instead of choosing specific individual jump destinations, consider the farthest reach reachable within the current jump boundary.

hints.title: Interval Boundary Jump Trigger Invariant
hints.text: Each jump defines a range of indices reachable; extending to the farthest reachable index within that window determines the next boundary.

hints.title: Farthest Reach Greedy Progression Procedure
hints.text: Track current jump boundary and farthest reach encountered. Iterate from index 0 to length minus 2: update farthest with index plus jump reach. When reaching current boundary, increment jump count and update boundary to farthest. Return jumps.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input array length or bit count
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively branching over every possible jump length leads to exponential O(2^N) paths without caching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy window tracking computes the minimum jumps in linear O(N) time with O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize this as an implicit BFS level-by-level traversal without needing an explicit queue.
